name: secret-guard
description: Your shell holds the keys to production. secret-guard stops Claude Code from reading, printing or leaking them: it blocks risky commands and file reads, and redacts secrets from tool output before Claude sees them.

block_credential_files.title: Block credential files
block_credential_files.description: Block shell commands and file tools that touch shell config and credential files (~/.zshrc, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.kube, ~/.vault-token and more).

block_env_dumps.title: Block environment dumps
block_env_dumps.description: Block env, printenv, export -p, declare -x and a bare set.

block_secret_commands.title: Block secret-printing commands
block_secret_commands.description: Block commands like op read, vault kv get, gh auth token and kubectl get secret -o yaml.

block_heredocs.title: Block unsafe heredocs
block_heredocs.description: Block heredocs that write files, or that would end early and run their text as commands.

ask_borderline.title: Ask before borderline commands
ask_borderline.description: Ask before kubeconfig flags, ECR login pipes and aws sts assume-role. When off, they run without asking.

redact_output.title: Redact secrets from tool output
redact_output.description: Replace anything shaped like a key or token in tool output before Claude reads it.

allow_commands.title: Allowed commands
allow_commands.description: Regular expressions for shell commands that are never blocked. Each must match the whole command. Their output is still redacted.

extra_paths.title: Extra credential paths
extra_paths.description: More files or folders to protect, like ~/.config/mytool or /etc/myapp/secrets. Commands and file tools that touch them are blocked.

extra_commands.title: Extra secret-printing commands
extra_commands.description: Regular expressions for more commands that print secrets, like \bmycli\s+secrets\s+show\b. Matching commands are blocked.
